text:
raj.platform: heads-up — I built a tiny repro where the JS SDK loses the auth header when bundled for edge via Vite and the app goes into silent retry loops. steps and logs below, anyone seen this? :eyes:

raj.platform: repro summary:
1) create sample edge function importing @redwood/inference-sdk (esm entry)
2) bundle with Vite target=esnext + esbuild commonjs transform enabled
3) runtime receives requests but Authorization header is missing from outgoing SDK fetch calls
4) SDK falls back to retry/refresh logic and we get a bunch of 401 -> noisy retries in logs

raj.platform: minimal package.json excerpt:
```json
{
  "name": "edge-auth-bug-repro",
  "type": "module",
  "dependencies": {
    "@redwood/inference-sdk": "^0.0.0"
  }
}
```

raj.platform: vite.config.js (important bits):
```js
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'
export default defineConfig({
  build: { target: 'esnext', ssr: true },
  optimizeDeps: { esbuildOptions: { target: 'es2020' } }
})
```

emma.dev: interesting — do you see the header present before bundling?

raj.platform: yes. in local node dev (unbundled) the SDK sends Authorization: Bearer <token>. after build+bundle it becomes absent. fetch calls show only content-type.

taylor-sdk: quick guess: interop between ESM default export and CJS shape changes the internal auth middleware import, causing null token at runtime. can you paste the compiled bundle snippet (where SDK constructs headers)?

raj.platform: pasted snippet from dist/server/handler.js:
```js
const sdk = require('@redwood/inference-sdk')
...
const headers = Object.assign({}, sdk.default?.auth?.getHeaders?.() || {})
fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers })
```

raj.platform: note the compiled code uses require() + sdk.default?.auth — that default access is undefined in our environment and getHeaders not invoked. looks like esbuild/rollup interop created a `.default` wrapper only in some bundlers.

olivia-eng: :thinking_face: that pattern rings a bell. Vite's esbuild transform can wrap ESM -> CJS. For edge runtimes that expect pure ESM imports this double-wrapping leads to accidental default-wrapping. Try enabling rollupOptions.output.exports = 'named' or set esbuild: { format: 'esm' } for the server build.

taylor-sdk: another angle — our SDK should be robust to both shapes. I'll file a small fix to check both module and module.default when resolving auth plugin. Short-term patch: in SDK's runtime-loader do something like:
```js
const m = importedModule;
const mod = m && m.__esModule ? m.default : m;
const auth = mod.auth || mod.default?.auth || null;
```
This avoids reliance on bundler behavior.

emma.dev: can you repro with Rollup and webpack? might be bundler-specific.

raj.platform: did quick tests: Rollup (with commonjs plugin) produced the same default-wrapping. Webpack 5 with module type set to 'es6' kept named export shape and header stayed. Vite + esbuild default transform was the worst.

ci-bot: build:edge-samples #2187654321 started — will run test matrix for vite/rollup/webpack (ETA ~15m)

olivia-eng: also saw typing pain: TS types for the SDK expect `AuthProvider` shape but generated d.ts from the bundler points to default export type, so consumers get confusing `any` loses. Might need to publish a small `exports` map in package.json to make entrypoints explicit for CJS/ESM + types: e.g.
```json
"exports": {
  ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js" }
},
"types": "dist/esm/index.d.ts"
```

taylor-sdk: agreed, we'll add explicit exports and adjust runtime resolution. I'll open a PR for:
- runtime fix (safe import resolution)
- package.json exports map + types entry
- unit test matrix where we run bundlers to ensure auth headers preserved

raj.platform: thanks. for anyone trying quick workaround locally: set VITE_SSR_NO_EXTERNAL to true and add `build.commonjsOptions.transformMixedEsModules: true` (forces esbuild to avoid default-wrapping) — that fixed the header in my tests.

emma.dev: can you paste the failing logs? curious about retry spam pattern.

raj.platform: logs snippet from edge function: 
```
[2026-03-14T09:21:03Z] ERROR inference: request failed status=401 token=missing auth_retry=1
[2026-03-14T09:21:03Z] ERROR inference: retrying auth refresh -> still 401
[2026-03-14T09:21:04Z] WARN retry: bumped backoff to 200ms
[2026-03-14T09:21:05Z] ERROR inference: request failed status=401 token=missing auth_retry=2
```

olivia-eng: filing internal KB note for edge bundler quirks + recommended build flags. plz include your minimal repro repo link when you push.

taylor-sdk: PR #492 drafted, includes tests and a short changelog entry. marking as patch release candidate. thanks for the repro — this was a subtle interoperability bug. :thumbsup:

raj.platform: will attach the tiny repro repo and the Vite config I used. can we also add a line in onboarding docs warning about build flags and exports map for customers using edge bundlers? saved a lot of time.

emma.dev: yes please — onboarding note + sample app with recommended vite/rollup settings would reduce friction.

ci-bot: build:edge-samples #2187654321 finished — vite: failed (auth header missing), rollup: failed (default wrapper), webpack: passed. See artifacts.

taylor-sdk: thanks all. I'll follow up when PR is merged and we'll back-port the workaround to the sample apps. closing thread but keep adding repro links here if you hit variants.
